results.notes: REPRODUCTION FAILED. This result records a diagnostic attempt; all requested computed fields are null under brief rule 3. Null se_type means that no new treatment-effect SE was computed. Round is 'all' because assignment was between people to four fixed AI-access schedules, not randomized within-person order; there is no paired or additional first_round analysis. Source variables are '终稿均' (Final Draft Average) and '初稿均' (Preliminary Draft Average). The SPSS value labels map 1=AI-first, 2=AI-follow, 3=AI-parallel, 4=Human-only. The blank SPSS row 113 was removed; the other 112 rows are distinct people with both draft scores. The counts reproduced above are explicitly the pre-exclusion valid pool, not final-model denominators. Eight people lack both Creative Personality and AI I Literacy (one-based SPSS rows [24, 35, 52, 53, 85, 92, 100, 108]); PDF p. 7 states five people had missing values and five MICE datasets were generated. No imputation index, imputed dataset, model inclusion flag, or exclusion list is in this deposit. Consequently the paper's exact MICE analysis cannot be rerun. The diagnostic uses complete cases and the specified four-arm OLS ANCOVA: final score ~ arm + first-draft score + age + gender + AI literacy + creative personality, with Human-only as reference. It starts with 104 people ({'AI-first': 25, 'AI-follow': 21, 'AI-parallel': 29, 'Human-only': 29}), applies one exclusion pass at Cook's D > 4/n = 0.0384615385, and refits. It excludes SPSS rows [3, 11, 45, 55, 79, 102], retaining 98 people ({'AI-first': 24, 'AI-follow': 21, 'AI-parallel': 26, 'Human-only': 27}). Adjusted means are predictions with all covariates set to their retained-sample means, identical across arms. These diagnostic means are compared with the printed means at two decimal places; they fail. The complete-case procedure is not the reported multiple-imputation procedure, and its retained counts cannot be substituted for the unreported paper-specific arm counts. For orientation, full-valid-pool unadjusted means are 4.808 (AI-follow) and 5.53620689655 (Human-only); these are not the paper's adjusted estimands and are not used as successful reproduction evidence. The paper does not identify the robust covariance estimator or the Cohen's-d standardizer, so the printed adjusted-mean SEs, pairwise p-values, and d are not labeled reproduced. Stored overall scores differ from the equal-weight average of their four component scores for 3 first drafts and 7 final drafts. The published aggregation rule and individual human-rater scores are absent; the supplied overall-score columns were used without repair. Full main markdown and materials supplement were read; the supplement contains task instructions and questionnaire excerpts, not imputation or analysis specifications.
